title: 第241章 顺利进入龙皇遗迹重塑肉身完美之法第242章 恐怖的祖龙印完美重塑肉身之法到手
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 她觉得自己夫君说的还是有道理的。
毕竟，自己夫君从来都没有错过。
敖琉璃朝前迈出了一步。
她身上冰蓝色的真丝长裙，在真空结界的微风中，轻轻摆动。
来到这扇决定龙族命运的青铜大门前。
一股恐怖的上位龙族威压，宛如实质般的潮水一般，朝着前方万丈高的青铜龙门席卷而去。
激荡在整片结界空间之中。
令敖琉璃以及旁边的御水感到愕然的是。
当这股强横的龙威轰击在青铜大门上的时候。
巨大的青铜大门却稳如泰山。
上面的两条巨龙雕像一动不动。
半天大门都没有半点反应。
有些无助地转过头，看了李长生一眼。
李长生站在遮天伞下，神色平静，对其投去了一个鼓励的眼神。
开这种顶级大能留下的副本，要是能一次性顺顺利利打开，才叫活见鬼了呢。
神之眼拥有【破妄】特性，能够看穿世间的一切漏洞。
龙宫遗迹也是客观存在的。
content_en:
"Okay."
Hearing this, Ao Liuli nodded.
She felt that what her husband said made sense.
You can try it.
After all, my husband never missed anything.
Ao Liuli took a step forward.
The ice blue silk dress on her body swayed gently in the breeze of the vacuum barrier.
The skirt has a very high slit.
Fair and straight long legs.
It is faintly visible as you move around.
Come to this bronze door that determines the fate of the dragon clan.
Take a deep breath.
The power of the true dragon exploded instantly.
A low dragon roar.
It came from deep within her body.
Immediately afterwards.
A terrifying high-level dragon clan's pressure, like a real tide, swept towards the thousands-foot-tall bronze dragon gate ahead.
The pure Yang dragon is mighty and mighty.
It stirred throughout the entire barrier space.
However.
What shocked Ao Liuli and Yu Shui next to her.
When this powerful dragon bombarded the bronze door.
The huge bronze door is as stable as a mountain.
The two giant dragon statues above were motionless.
There was no response from the gate for a long time.
…
Isn’t Longwei good?
Just try blood essence.
Ao Liuli bit her lower lip.
He turned his head somewhat helplessly and glanced at Li Changsheng.
Li Changsheng stood under the umbrella, his expression calm, and he cast an encouraging look at him.
In fact, he had already foreseen it.
It would be a hell to open a copy left by such a top power if it could be opened smoothly at once.
If the blood essence also fails.
He will start plan B.
Turn on [God's Eye].
The Eye of God possesses the property of "Destroying Illusions" and can see through all loopholes in the world.
Logically speaking.
The ruins of the Dragon Palace also exist objectively.
【Breaking Delusion】You should also be able to see through its loopholes.
If Ao Liuli can't open the door.
He can only go to plan B.
……
at this time.
